text:
elena: Heads-up — setting up SEV path for CloudNexus Marketplace launch next week. Need agreement on shared channel + war-room triggers. Quick sync?
matt: +1. Which escalation tiers do we want? Partner triggers -> S0? S1? I propose partner-impacting = SEV-1/2.
sara: I can own partner comms. Suggest shared channel: #pn-cloudnexus-sev. Limit to named liaisons + oncall.
jonathan: Sales wants a notify for customer escalations that hit SLA. Add me and @elena to paging list.
elena: Proposed oncall lane:
- partner-liaison (sara)
- infra oncall (matt)
- eng owner (rotation)
Create channel, and use war-room when >15 min outage.
matt: ops-bot can auto-create warroom and bridge. Command:
```/ops warroom create --channel #pn-cloudnexus-sev --owner @sara --severity SEV-2```
ops-bot: warroom created: link https://warrooms.redwood/2520001111 — logs ingestion + metrics stream enabled :gear: 
sara: added initial contact list to doc: https://redwood.atlassian/partnerships/cloudnexus-sev-runbook (please review). I'll add SI POC and CloudNexus support emails.
jonathan: Confirming notification cadence: page immediately for SEV-1, 2-min summary for SEV-2, 30-min for SEV-3. OK?
matt: Fine. Also recommend temporary routing policy: route to Dedicated region first, fallback to Hosted in us-west if capacity constrained.
elena: For handoffs: when partner takes over, post "handoff: partner" and include contact, time, and expected SLA. Short blurb example:
```
handoff: partner
time: 2026-03-22T18:27Z
contact: support@cloudnexus.com
notes: partner will run remediation for SI integration
```
sara: I'll set auto-reminder for 15m post-warroom creation to check external comms.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled in 15m.
matt: One more: log channel membership in the ticket and restrict posting to liaisons + oncall. Use this snippet in channel topic:
"SEV channel — liaison: @sara, oncall: @matt — ephemeral posts from customers blocked"
jonathan: LGTM. Do we want a postmortem owner assigned automatically? Suggest: owner = eng-product manager of the integration.
elena: Agree. I'll create the ticket template and add to repo.
sara: I'll run a 30-min dry run Tues 09:00 PT with CloudNexus support. All in favor?
matt: :thumbsup: 
jonathan: :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Dry run scheduled: 2026-03-24T16:00Z — invite sent to participants.
